environment.execution: Detached synthetic CLI workflows on Linux

hosted_observation: Exact assigned head matched. Controller reports required platform builds passed. Fresh PR observation showed seven successful build entries and one additional Intel Mac build in progress; publication skipped. No repeated wait requested.
initial_test_correction: The initial mid-decode cancellation test assumed more than40 callbacks for a96-byte container. The JDK uses bulk primitive reads, so the test now first measures callback count and cancels halfway; final-result cancellation is checked separately. No unexecuted threshold bound is claimed.
limitations: Input/output byte bounds are enforced, but these counts are not heap/decoded-memory measurements. Leaf budget is checked after each size16 tree parses; at most one additional4096-leaf tree can be parsed before rejection. Branch allocation is bounded by the size16 parser and8MiB input, not measured here. Encoder retains a bounded growable buffer and final copy. Decode accepts an already allocated detached byte array. No compression, streaming disk publication, model dependency definitions, atomic world-generation swap, undo or network transfer is integrated.
next: Add and validate a bounded global dependency manifest, then integrate region codec with versioned save/load, atomic generation publication, conflict-safe undo and late joining while retaining old-world compatibility.
playtest: Playtest: CLI encoded and decoded all three migrated terrain-version cohorts, checked byte-exact re-encoding, and replayed every decoded cell against raw and legacy canonical worlds. Expected preserved air, LED/materials, model IDs, negative/world boundaries and untouched terrain; observed equality. Hostile-input/cancellation/retry and existing tool regressions passed. Browser/native playtesting does not apply to this tools-only codec change. All224 production/harness source hashes remain unchanged; existing native media still matches game source.
qualification: Production admission caps and saves/network/history are unchanged. Full city/maximum admission,20-run performance and physical-GPU/shaped-network/32-rendered-client qualification remain pending. Stable rollout remains gated.

tests.rejections: 47 executed cases include format/version/count/coordinate limits, duplicate regions, duplicate/unordered cell indices, region/index mismatch, invalid octree resolution/tag/material and fractional model, CRC, trailing bytes, truncation, byte/cell/region/leaf budgets, cancellation before/during encode/decode and immediately before result return, and interruption. Golden container bytes are constructed independently of the prototype encoder; semantic mutations recompute CRC. Exact budgets, empty records, byte-exact round trips and retry succeed.

wire.fields: Big-endian magic/version, seed, terrain generator version, region count, unique region coordinates, unsigned16 cell count, strictly increasing unsigned16 local cell index plus validated Protocol.CellState payload; CRC32 trailer.
wire.publication: Decode validates a private complete result before returning. Encoding checks cancellation again after copying final output bytes. No live world is mutated.
wire.scope: Private, uncompressed diagnostic format; no game importer accepts it.
